title: Garden vs Zombies
description: Defend your backyard lawn by gathering falling sun, planting peashooters, sunflowers, and walnut barriers, and halting waves of quirky zombies.
controls: Click Tap to Start, choose Adventure mode, collect falling sun orbs, and click seed packets then lawn tiles to plant defenders.

zh-CN.title: 植物大战僵尸
zh-CN.description: 国民级经典塔防回忆杀：收集阳光种植向日葵、豌豆射手与坚果墙，排兵布阵阻挡一波波来袭的僵尸大军。
zh-CN.controls: 鼠标点击「Tap to start」开始冒险，点击收集掉落阳光，选择上方植物卡牌后再点草坪格子即可种植防御。
